entry.name: fluid.bufnmf~
entry.digest: Buffer-Based Non-Negative Matrix Factorisation on Spectral Frames
entry.description: Decomposes the spectrum of a sound into a number of components using Non-Negative Matrix Factorisation (NMF)

attributes.name: activations
attributes.digest: Activations Buffer
attributes.description: The buffer where the different activations will be written to and/or read from: the behaviour is set in the following argument. Ifis provided, no activation will be returned.

attributes.name: actmode
attributes.digest: Activations Buffer Update Mode
attributes.description: This flag decides how the activation buffer passed as the previous argument is treated.

choices.label: The activations are seeded randomly, and the resulting ones will be written after the process in the passed buffer. The buffer is resized tochannels andlength.
The passed buffer is considered as seed for the activations. Its dimensions should match the values above. The resulting activations will replace the seed ones.
The passed buffer is considered as a template for the activations, and will therefore not change. Its dimensions should match the values above.
